name: hebrew-auto-translate
description: Automatically translates Hebrew prompts to English before sending to LLM, then requests response in Hebrew. Saves up to 50% on input tokens.
author: Hebrew Token Saver

onPrompt.description: Automatically intercept and translate Hebrew prompts

useRtlFormatting.description: Use RTL formatting for Hebrew output

hebrewThreshold.description: Minimum percentage of Hebrew characters to detect as Hebrew

parameters.name: --english
parameters.description: Request English response instead of Hebrew

parameters.name: --rtl
parameters.description: Use RTL formatting for Hebrew output

parameters.name: --force
parameters.description: Force translation even if not Hebrew
